engineWork.name: Additional Ikon
engineWork.reason: Grants a fourth ikon of any type — an extra exemplar ikon selection the builder should offer; effectChoices has no ikon filter and the ikon list is too large to enumerate as options.

engineWork.name: Additional Servings
engineWork.reason: Raises versatile vials per day to 5 (then 6, then 7 on repeat takes) — a tracked daily resource count on the sheet; no legal field sets a class resource total.

engineWork.name: Advanced Alchemy
engineWork.reason: Lets you create 4 alchemical consumables during daily preparations — the app models Advanced Alchemy, and this record sets no item count for the dedication.

engineWork.name: Advanced Efficient Alchemy
engineWork.reason: Raises the advanced alchemy item maximum to 8 + Int (10 + Int at 16th) — a number the modelled Advanced Alchemy panel should show; no legal field sets it.

engineWork.name: Advanced Herbalism
engineWork.reason: Raises herbal items created per day with advanced alchemy to 6 (8 on a second take) — a tracked daily item count; no legal field sets it.

engineWork.name: Advanced Order Training
engineWork.reason: Grants the greater order benefit of whichever Hellknight order you belong to — a concrete benefit conditional on an earlier choice; nothing grants it and no legal field expresses a choice-dependent grant of another record.

engineWork.name: Advanced Poisoncraft
engineWork.reason: Raises poisons created per day with advanced alchemy to 6 (8 on a second take) — a tracked daily item count; no legal field sets it.

engineWork.name: Agile Grace
engineWork.reason: Your multiple attack penalty with agile weapons and agile unarmed attacks becomes –3/–6 instead of –4/–8 — the strike breakdown shows MAP, so this is a wrong number without a fix; no legal field alters MAP.

engineWork.name: Alchemical Power
engineWork.reason: You become an EXPERT in the alchemist class DC — a proficiency rank on a derived sheet number (the class DC shown for the dedication); nothing raises it, and no legal field sets class DC proficiency.

engineWork.name: Amp Focus
engineWork.reason: Refocus should restore ALL Focus Points instead of 1. The sheet's Refocus control hardcodes +1 (src/sheet/SpellsTab.tsx, className 'refocus-btn', title 'Refocus (restore 1 focus point)'), and no legal field changes the refocus amount — a refocus-recovery lane is missing.

engineWork.name: Ancestral Mind
engineWork.reason: Ancestry/heritage innate spells become occult and use the psychic spellcasting attribute for spell attack and spell DC. build.ts computes the innate entry's profile from the granting source (Charisma by default) and there is no field that retunes an existing innate entry's tradition/key attribute — an innate-entry retune lane is missing.

engineWork.name: Armor Regiment Training
engineWork.reason: Treats heavy armor as 1 Bulk lighter. Bulk and encumbrance are computed and warned on (bulk carried vs encumberedAt), but no legal field lets a feat adjust an item category's Bulk — a feat→Bulk lane is missing. (The rest — resting in armor and exploration travel Speed — legitimately needs nothing.) Duplicate record of armored-regiment-training; fix both together.

engineWork.name: Armor Specialist
engineWork.reason: Grants the armor specialization effects for every armor you are proficient with — real defensive benefits (e.g. plate's physical resistance, chain's crit-to-hit conversion) that depend on the worn armor's group. Nothing in src models armor specialization at all (no match for 'armor specialization' anywhere in src), and no legal field expresses an armor-group-conditional defence.

engineWork.name: Armored Regiment Training
engineWork.reason: Duplicate printing of Armor Regiment Training: treating heavy armor as 1 Bulk lighter is a real change to the tracked Bulk/encumbrance total and no field lets a feat adjust armor Bulk. Resting in armor and the exploration travel-Speed clause need nothing.

engineWork.name: Dogfang Bite
engineWork.reason: Your beak unarmed attack gains the versatile S trait — a permanent change to a Strike the player uses. grantedStrikes can only CREATE an unarmed attack with traits; there is no lane to add a trait to an unarmed Strike granted elsewhere (the tengu beak), and the dogtooth-tengu heritage's own 'deadly d8' is unmodelled for the same reason.

engineWork.name: Domain Focus
engineWork.reason: Refocus completely refills your focus pool instead of restoring 1 point. The sheet has a real Refocus control (SpellsTab.tsx: 'Refocus (restore 1 focus point)'), but there is no field or flag that tells it to restore the whole pool, so this feat is inert.

engineWork.name: Dragon Arcana
engineWork.reason: Adds ten named draconic-bloodline spells to your spell LIST, widening what you may learn or add to your repertoire. This is exactly the 'let the player pick what the rules give them' case, but no field expands a character's available spell list (innateSpells grants casts, effectChoices/spellFilter picks a specific spell) — the descRefs on this record are display links only.

engineWork.name: Eclectic Skill
engineWork.reason: Sets your proficiency bonus for UNTRAINED skill checks equal to your level and lets you attempt trained-only (and, at legendary Occultism, expert-only) checks. Every untrained skill modifier on the sheet is wrong without it, and the same lane is missing for Untrained Improvisation (which appears in src only as a feat-grant target, never as a proficiency rule).

engineWork.name: Efficient Alchemy
engineWork.reason: src/sheet/AlchemyPanel.tsx hardcodes `const budget = 4 + intMod` and blocks preparing past it, so a character with this feat is still capped at 4 + Int instead of the printed 6 + Int; no listed field raises the Advanced Alchemy daily budget.

engineWork.name: Efficient Preparation
engineWork.reason: build.ts sets `commanderTactics = { ..., preparedMax: 3 }` unconditionally, so the extra prepared tactic never arrives; no listed field raises a prepared-tactic count.

engineWork.name: Effortless Reach
engineWork.reason: Permanently adds the reach trait to all your unarmed attacks — a real change to every unarmed strike line — but the strike builder reads traits from the weapon/unarmed record only, and no listed field adds a trait to a character's strikes (the existing feat-level `reach` field sets natural body reach, which would wrongly extend wielded weapons too).

engineWork.name: Embodiment Of The Balance
engineWork.reason: Adds Heal and Harm to the apparition spell repertoire — real, permanent spell access the player never receives; build.ts assembles that repertoire solely from the attuned apparition options' `grantedSpells`, and no listed field lets a FEAT add spells to a repertoire.

engineWork.name: Enlarged Chassis
engineWork.reason: Constant enlarge is a real permanent package (Large size, +5 feet reach, +2 status to melee damage, clumsy 1 until the Enhancement removes it) and none of it reaches the sheet — the id appears only as a label in the automaton core-feat option list. The feat fields sizeOverride/reach in build.ts would carry the size and reach half, but the melee-damage bonus and the clumsy have no lane.

engineWork.name: Enticing Dwelling
engineWork.reason: Doubles the spirit wisps your spirit dwelling gains each day (1 -> 2). Wisps are a per-day counter other exorcist feats spend; nothing in the app tracks them. The right home is a feat-gated counter in CLASS_RESOURCES (src/rules/classResources.ts, the `feat:` form used for Rage/Panache), which no audit field can write.

engineWork.name: Exemplar Expertise
engineWork.reason: Raises your exemplar class DC proficiency to expert. Feat-granted class DCs exist only as `classDcGrant` (a flat TRAINED secondary DC in build.ts ~2677) and no lane raises that rank — the same gap already recorded for alchemical-power.

engineWork.name: Exorcist Dedication
engineWork.reason: The dedication creates a spirit dwelling that gains a spirit wisp every day (and can be re-primed with a 10-minute ritual); wisps are the currency every other exorcist feat spends. Nothing tracks them. A feat-gated counter in CLASS_RESOURCES (src/rules/classResources.ts) is the right home and no audit field can write it.

engineWork.name: Expert Cathartic Spellcasting
engineWork.reason: The expert tier of the Cathartic Mage's spontaneous casting (ranks 4-6 slots). cathartic-mage-dedication is NOT in CASTER_ARCHETYPES (src/rules/casterArchetypes.ts), so neither the basic nor the expert feat grants a slot — the whole archetype's casting is inert. Registering the dedication is engine work no audit field can express.

engineWork.name: Expert Kinetic Control
engineWork.reason: Expert in kineticist class DC and impulse attack rolls for the archetype. Feat-granted class DCs are flat TRAINED entries (classDcGrant, build.ts ~2677) with no rank ladder, and impulse attack rolls have no feat-driven track at all — the same lane gap recorded for alchemical-power.

engineWork.name: Expert Red Mantis Magic
engineWork.reason: The expert tier of Red Mantis divine casting (ranks 4-6 slots). red-mantis-assassin-dedication is absent from CASTER_ARCHETYPES, and the archetype's feat ids ('basic/expert-red-mantis-magic') do not even match mk()'s basic-/expert-<slug>-spellcasting pattern, so the tier can never be detected. Engine/registry work.

engineWork.name: Expert Scroll Cache
engineWork.reason: Adds a daily temporary scroll of a 3rd-rank spell (4th at 14th, 5th at 16th) that the player PICKS. Nothing offers the pick — basic-scroll-cache was already judged the same way (judge-2) and the scroll cache is unmodelled end to end; effectChoices' spellFilter grants innate casts, not level-scaling temporary scroll items.

engineWork.name: Expert Snowcasting
engineWork.reason: The expert tier of the Gelid Shard archetype's spellcasting (the basic tier is the 'snowcaster' feat). No gelid-shard dedication is registered in CASTER_ARCHETYPES and the feat ids do not follow mk()'s basic-/expert-<slug>-spellcasting pattern, so no archetype slots are ever unlocked. Engine/registry work.

engineWork.name: Explosive Savant
engineWork.reason: Two-tier group re-categorisation of proficiency (bombs and martial firearms count as SIMPLE, advanced firearms count as MARTIAL). FEAT_LANE_GRANTS.weaponFamiliarity takes an explicit weapon-id list plus ONE mirrorCategory, and core.json holds 172 bomb ids and 119 firearm ids across both tiers — one entry cannot carry two tiers, and neither can it express 'every weapon in this group'. Needs a group/trait-scoped familiarity rule (e.g. weaponFamiliarity accepting {groups:['bomb','firearm'], category:'martial'} with a per-tier mirrorCategory).

engineWork.name: Extend Elixir
engineWork.reason: Doubles the duration of every infused elixir with a duration of 1 minute or longer that you drink. Item-driven consumable modes carry a fixed printed `duration` string (core.modes item-* entries) and nothing scales it per-character, so the alchemist's doubled durations never reach the sheet. Needs a duration multiplier on item modes gated on this feat (and the Quick Alchemy 10-minute cap).

engineWork.name: Extradimensional Stash
engineWork.reason: Grants an inherent 5-Bulk extradimensional space that functions as a bag of holding with no Bulk of its own — real carrying capacity the app models for items (itemType 'container' with ignoredBulk, Character.inventory containerInstanceId) but that no feat can confer: there is no grantsItems/container lane anywhere in src/rules. Needs a feat→inventory-container grant.

engineWork.name: Fast Recovery
engineWork.reason: Doubles the Hit Points you regain from resting, and reduces drained by 2 per night instead of 1. rest() in src/rules/play.ts computes `recovered = level * conMod` with no per-feat multiplier, and nothing steps drained down at all, so the app's Rest button gives this character the wrong number. Needs a rest-recovery modifier lane (the disease/poison stage reductions are a GM-run affliction track and can stay prose).

engineWork.name: Fearsome Fangs
engineWork.reason: Upgrades the Ursine Avenger Form strikes (jaws 1d8→1d12, claws 1d6→1d8). The form is modelled as stances['ursine-avenger-form'] with fixed strike dice; StanceDef has senseIfFeat for feat-gated SENSES but no equivalent feat-gated strike-die upgrade, and a feat-side grantedStrikes would create duplicate attacks rather than replace the form's. Needs a strikeIfFeat/die-upgrade gate on StanceDef.

engineWork.name: Ferrousoul
engineWork.reason: The base Fist upgrade (die d6, loses nonlethal, gains modular B/P/S) is hardcoded in derive.ts as `fistDieUpgraded` = powerful-fist / warrior-automaton / warrior-jotunborn only; no data field upgrades the built-in Fist profile, and grantedStrikes would add a SECOND fist row instead of replacing it (an over-grant).

engineWork.name: Fey Caller
engineWork.reason: Adds Illusory Disguise, Illusory Object and Illusory Scene to the druid's spell list as primal spells — a real expansion of what the player may prepare, but the spell picker offers only the tradition list and no field adds specific spells to it.

engineWork.name: Flexible Spellcaster Dedication
engineWork.reason: The record's text grants an extra cantrip per day (four instead of three, five instead of four at 4th level) and nothing delivers it: cantripsKnown() is a hardcoded per-class number and spellSlotBonus explicitly skips rank 0 (build.ts `r > 0`).

engineWork.name: Forgotten Presence
engineWork.reason: The Recall Knowledge penalty falls on other creatures, but "Add Rewrite Memory to your spell list as a primal spell" is a real player-facing grant: without it the primal-filtered spell picker will never offer Rewrite Memory. No field adds a single spell to a character's spell list/tradition (innateSpells would wrongly give it as a free innate casting), and the two other feats with the same wording (tupilaq-carver, dragon-arcana) carry no field either.

engineWork.name: Frozen Breadth
engineWork.reason: Really grants the player extra repertoire spells and extra spell slots. spellSlotBonus supports {perRank, exceptHighest, entryId} (occult-breadth uses exactly that shape for the bard archetype), but the gelid shard archetype has no spellcasting entry with slots to attach to — first-frost supplies only spellcastingGrant + at-will innateSpells, and snowcaster/expert-snowcasting/master-snowcasting carry no fields at all. Writing spellSlotBonus with no entryId would over-grant slots to the character's main caster. Needs the gelid-shard slot/repertoire entry first, plus a repertoire-size increase (no field exists for spells known).

engineWork.name: Ghost-path Epiphany
engineWork.reason: Grants the unholy sanctification trait and knowledge of two rituals (Call Spirit, Commune). No field grants a FIXED sanctification (only `choice` flags where the player picks holy/unholy) and nothing grants known rituals — innateSpells would wrongly make them per-day innate casts. The secondary-caster substitution is table-resolved.

engineWork.name: Gifted Power
engineWork.reason: A real extra spell slot at your HIGHEST rank, usable only for mystery-granted spells. spellSlotBonus can only say perRank (every rank — a huge over-grant) or byRank with a fixed rank number, and the highest rank moves with level; there is no 'highest rank only' form and no way to restrict the slot's contents.

engineWork.name: Gnome Polyglot
engineWork.reason: Learn three new languages. The sheet tracks languages (character.languages, its own rail card) but NO feat field grants them — the only addedLanguages field is on the per-character override record, not on feats, and even core Multilingual is unmodelled. The lane itself is missing.

engineWork.name: Grand Scroll Esoterica
engineWork.reason: Adds a daily temporary scroll with a 6th-rank spell (7th at 20th level) — a real per-day resource whose spell the player PICKS. Neither Scroll Esoterica nor Elaborate Scroll Esoterica carries any field, and there is no lane for daily temporary items: effectChoices+spellFilter only grants innate or focus spells, which would be an over-grant (unlimited-target casting rather than a one-use scroll).

engineWork.name: Greater Armament
engineWork.reason: Adds eight property runes (Brilliant, Corrosive, Flaming, Frost, Holy, Shock, Thundering, Unholy) to the daily rune pick that Harbinger's Armament already implements as a `choice` with flag harbingerRune and five options. The player's daily menu stays at five. No field lets one feat EXPAND another record's choice options; adding a second choice here would grant a second rune, an over-grant.

engineWork.name: Guerrilla Weaponry
engineWork.reason: In your hands a blowgun's base damage becomes 1d4 and it gains deadly d4 — a change to a wielded weapon's own damage die and traits on your Strikes. strikeDamage only ADDS damage (StrikeDamageRider) and there is no per-character weapon-statistics override lane. (The Guerrilla Assault action half needs nothing.)

engineWork.name: Hellknight-Errant
engineWork.reason: Raises your mental resistance to 5 + your number of Hellknight archetype feats — a Defenses-card number. It cannot be written today: hellknight-dedication already stores resistances [{"type":"mental","value":"@actor.flags.system.hellknightArchetype.featCount + 1"}], and the formula substituter in src/rules/derive.ts:604-627 supports only @actor.level, ability mods and Speeds, refusing any other @actor token — so the dedication's resistance is already dead and a copy with +5 would be too. A flat number would misstate it. Needs an archetype-feat-count token in the resistance formula evaluator. (The Warding Shift action half needs nothing.)

engineWork.name: Herbal Forager
engineWork.reason: Each day at daily preparations you get one temporary alchemical item with the healing trait, chosen from formulas you know — a real daily pick the builder never offers. effectChoices can't express it (it needs fixed options or a spellFilter; there is no item filter), and advancedAlchemy is the alchemist's Advanced Alchemy budget (src/rules/build.ts:2601-2614 → AlchemyPanel), which would hand a centaur any formula rather than one healing item. Needs a daily-prep temporary-item lane restricted by trait and count.

engineWork.name: Hilt Hammer
engineWork.reason: Every melee weapon you wield gains the versatile B trait (a real change to your Strikes' damage options), and no field can add a trait to wielded weapons — the strikes engine reads traits off the item record only.

engineWork.name: Hurl at the Horizon
engineWork.reason: The imbued ikon's immanence gives your weapon the thrown 15 ft trait (or +10 ft thrown range) — a real change to that weapon's Strikes. No field adds a trait to a weapon, and ikon imbue/immanence state is unmodelled (only mated-birds-in-paired-flight has any ikon field).

engineWork.name: Implement Initiate
engineWork.reason: 'You gain your implement's initiate benefit.' Thaumaturge Dedication already records the pick (choice flag dedicationImplement), and the benefits exist as classFeatures `initiate-benefit-<implement>`, but build.ts only pushes them inside `if (ownsClass('thaumaturge'))` (build.ts ~3043), so an archetype character gets nothing. No data field points a feat at a classFeature.

engineWork.name: Improved Elemental Blast
engineWork.reason: 'The damage of your elemental blast increases by one die' (repeatable; maxTakable 3). deriveBlastStrikes (derive.ts ~1495) computes dice purely from character level — `1 + [5,9,13,17]` — so an archetype kineticist's blast ignores this feat entirely; no field expresses a damage-die count.

engineWork.name: Incredible Investiture
engineWork.reason: The invested-item cap is hard-coded at 10 in src/sheet/InventoryTab.tsx (INVESTED_LIMIT, enforced on the Invest button, on drag-to-invest and in the x/10 badge), so a character with this feat literally cannot invest their 11th and 12th item. No legal field raises the cap.

engineWork.name: Instinct Ability
engineWork.reason: Gives an archetype barbarian the instinct ability of the instinct chosen at Barbarian Dedication (Draconic Rage's damage, Animal Instinct's unarmed Strike, Giant Instinct's larger weapon, and so on). Barbarian Dedication records the pick in the `barbarianInstinct` choice flag, but nothing in src/ ever reads it — rageStrikeRider in src/rules/derive.ts only honours subclassId for a real barbarian and hands an archetype a flat 2 damage — so the feat delivers nothing and no legal field can express instinct abilities.

engineWork.name: Aura Enhancement
engineWork.reason: Adds two named spells (Benediction, Malediction) to the pool you can prepare in your divine font slots. No allowed field adds specific spells to a prepared pool, and the Battle Harbinger font is not built at all — battle-harbinger-dedication is absent from CASTER_ARCHETYPES and its registry entries only grant Toughness plus a skill.

engineWork.name: Aura of Courage
engineWork.reason: Every frightened condition YOU gain is reduced by 1 — the same shape the app already models in the condition-marker lane (the-fool: 'any stupefied condition you gain has its value reduced by 1'; face-your-fears on frightened). No allowed field expresses a condition marker, so it needs the registry lane. The allies' end-of-turn reduction is correctly ally-side.

engineWork.name: Awakened Yaoguai Heritage
engineWork.reason: It grants a versatile-heritage character the full mechanical benefits of a yaoguai heritage (and unlocks heritage-gated feats). No allowed field grants a heritage's benefits and there is no second-heritage lane.

engineWork.name: Axe Thrower
engineWork.reason: Two real grants, neither expressible: every one-handed axe you wield GAINS the thrown trait (10 feet) and already-thrown axes get +10 feet of range — there is no weapon-trait or range-increment lane — and the critical specialization applies only to THROWN axe attacks, which critSpec/critSpecWeapons would over-grant to melee axe crits.

engineWork.name: Basic Modification
engineWork.reason: It is a PICK (a basic innovation modification) the builder never offers: inventorModificationOptions / INVENTOR_TIER_LEVEL and build.inventorModifications are gated on the inventor CLASS and an innovation subclass, so an Inventor-archetype character gets no choice. effectChoices can't express it — the legal options are classFeatures filtered by innovation type and the armor sub-gate, not a fixed list.

engineWork.name: Basic Scroll Cache
engineWork.reason: A daily-preparations PICK (one common 1st-rank spell, plus a 2nd-rank one at 8th level) that becomes a temporary scroll; nothing offers it. effectChoices' spellFilter can only grant a spell as innate or focus, which would misrepresent it — a scroll is read at the scroll's own rank/DC and works for non-casters — so this needs a temporary-consumable daily-choice lane.

engineWork.name: Insulated Poppet
engineWork.reason: The feat REMOVES the electricity/cold weakness the tsukumogami-poppet heritage grants through its poppet-material effectChoice. Every IWR field is additive (weaknesses only add entries); there is no lane for a feat that cancels a weakness granted by a heritage, so the sheet keeps showing weakness 5.

engineWork.name: Intense Implement
engineWork.reason: Grants the ADEPT benefit of the thaumaturge's THIRD implement. build.ts's implement pipeline (~3040-3061) only ever assigns adept to the first two implements ('never the third implement'), and no feat field can push an implement benefit, so the third implement's adept benefit never appears.

engineWork.name: Invoke Offense
engineWork.reason: Grants a real unarmed attack (1d8 spirit, brawling, agile/finesse/magical, gaining striking-rune dice at 5/12/20) but ONLY for the duration of Enter Spirit Trance. grantedStrikes is permanent (build.ts collectGrantedNaturals) and ModeDef carries no grantedStrikes field, so there is no way to express a Strike that exists only while a mode/trance is on without over-granting it permanently.

engineWork.name: Iron Fists
engineWork.reason: Your fist unarmed attacks permanently lose nonlethal and gain shove; the derived baseline Fist still shows nonlethal and no shove. Same modelling petrified-skin already uses (a granted brawling natural attack with the printed traits).

engineWork.name: Iruxi Unarmed Cunning
engineWork.reason: Grants weapon critical specialization with your claw and lizardfolk-feat unarmed attacks. critSpec/critSpecWeapons can only narrow by weapon group, trait, or base id — granted naturals get base 'natural:<n>' (derive.ts ~1671) and share the brawling group with gauntlets/fists/saps, so the only expressible narrowing would over-grant crit spec to other brawling weapons. No lane can name 'unarmed attacks granted by lizardfolk records'.

engineWork.name: Late Awakener
engineWork.reason: "You gain all the mechanical benefits of the awakened animal heritage you selected at 1st level" - a real grant (that heritage's speeds, unarmed attack, senses, plus qualifying for heritage-gated feats) for a character who took a versatile heritage. No listed field can apply a second heritage's mechanics or unlock its feat prerequisites.

engineWork.name: Lightning Rings' Intervention
engineWork.reason: 'Your familiar gains the Lightning Needles ability' is a concrete grant to your familiar — the ability record lightning-needles exists in core.json's familiarAbilities, but no registry entry attaches it, so the familiar block never shows it.

engineWork.name: Lightning Rings' Overcharge
engineWork.reason: 'Your familiar gains the Lightning Armillary ability' — the lightning-armillary familiar ability exists in core.json but nothing attaches it to the familiar.

engineWork.name: Living Rune
engineWork.reason: The feat gives the PLAYER a real, permanent rune slot on their own body that holds one armor property rune and applies its effects to them; the app only etches property runes onto armor items in inventory, so there is no lane for a body-worn property rune slot (and no way to pick which rune goes in it).

engineWork.name: Martial Artist Dedication
engineWork.reason: 'The damage die for your fist unarmed attacks becomes 1d6 instead of 1d4' is a real Strike change and nothing delivers it. The lane is a HARD-CODED list: derive.ts ~1692 `fistDieUpgraded = ownedFeatureIds(...).has('powerful-fist') || heritage warrior-automaton/warrior-jotunborn`. Martial Artist must be added there — but unlike Powerful Fist it does NOT drop the nonlethal trait (it only removes the -2 lethal-attack penalty), so the existing branch can't be reused verbatim. grantedStrikes is wrong here: it would add a SECOND 'Fist' row beside the d4 baseline rather than upgrading it.

engineWork.name: Master Scroll Cache
engineWork.reason: 'Add a single scroll with a 6th-rank spell (7th at 20th level)' to your daily scrolls is a real free consumable the player picks each day, and no lane exists: nothing in src/rules references scroll caches, and Basic/Expert Scroll Cache are equally inert. What is missing is a daily-preparations GRANTED-CONSUMABLE lane (a scroll of a chosen spell at a fixed rank, refreshed daily) — dailyChoices.ts only records a pick, it cannot mint an item.

engineWork.name: Master Summoner
engineWork.reason: 'During daily preparations, designate one spell slot to become TWO summoning slots of the same rank' is a real net gain of a spell slot, chosen daily and restricted to summoning/incarnate spells. No lane: spellSlotBonus can only ADD slots (perRank/byRank) with no rank choice, no slot consumed, and no restriction on what can be prepared in them; dailyChoices.ts records a morning pick but cannot alter the slot table. Needs a restricted-slot / slot-conversion lane.

engineWork.name: Miraculous Flight
engineWork.reason: Your signature vehicle gains a fly Speed. Vehicles are a real CompanionKind in this app and COMPANION_MODS already carries speeds:{fly:'land'} grants, so this is the companion-mod registry lane, not engine work.

engineWork.name: Modular Dynamo
engineWork.reason: Your dynamo unarmed attack gains the modular trait plus a chosen alternate configuration with its own damage die, damage type and traits (power driver, percussive striker, rotating sickle, entangling barbs, extendable baton), repeatable. unarmedTraits can only add traits to an existing strike, and grantedStrikes can't be presented as switchable configurations of one attack (the base sterling-dynamo-dedication strikes are even named 'Label'). No lane expresses a switchable strike configuration.

engineWork.name: Monstrous Inclinations
engineWork.reason: Adds Monstrosity Form to your apparition spell repertoire — a genuinely new castable spell. grantedSpells (the repertoire-grant field) exists only on subclass options in types.ts, never on feats, and spellFilter can only grant a pick as innate or focus. No feat-level repertoire-grant lane exists.

engineWork.name: Mysterious Repertoire
engineWork.reason: You may hold one spell from another tradition in your divine repertoire (swappable, cast as divine). The repertoire picker is restricted to the divine list, and no lane lets a feat widen it: grantedSpells exists only on subclass options in types.ts, and SpellChoiceFilter.grantAs allows only 'innate' or 'focus', which would grant a use-limited spell rather than a repertoire slot.

engineWork.name: Pack Rat
engineWork.reason: The app models container capacity (derive.ts computes each container's load vs item.capacity.bulk and blocks over-capacity drops), so a +50% capacity on mundane containers and vehicles is a real sheet effect. No listed field or registry expresses a container-capacity multiplier — bulkLimitBonus is the character's own Bulk limit, which this feat explicitly does not change.

engineWork.name: Pact of the Rune Dragon
engineWork.reason: You immediately learn 10 languages of your choice — a real, player-picked sheet element. No feat in core.json carries any language field and there is no language lane on feats (OpenChoiceFrom's 'language' type is not reachable from a feat record), so nothing can deliver it.

engineWork.name: Perfect Mutagen
engineWork.reason: Mutagens are real consumable MODES whose drawbacks are negative modifiers on the sheet (e.g. item-bendy-arm-mutagen-lesser's -1 Athletics). This feat removes those drawbacks for mutagens you crafted, and no field or registry can suppress part of a mode.

engineWork.name: Plentiful Snares
engineWork.reason: Doubles the free daily prepared snares from Snarecrafter Dedication. That count IS modelled - snareAllowance() in src/rules/snareFormulas.ts returns prepared 4/6/8 by Crafting rank - but it takes only the Crafting rank, so nothing doubles it and the feat is inert. No record field expresses 'double a computed snare allowance'.

engineWork.name: Quick Alchemy
engineWork.reason: The archetype grants the Quick Alchemy action, which the app DOES model — but AlchemyPanel is gated on classId==='alchemist' and the versatile-vials resource only exists in CLASS_RESOURCES['alchemist'], so an archetype taker gets nothing. Needs a lane to unlock the alchemy panel/vial resource from a feat.

engineWork.name: Radiant Armament
engineWork.reason: Adds Astral and Brilliant (plus Holy or Unholy by sanctification) to the list you pick from for Blessed Armament. Blessed Armament IS modelled (classFeature blessed-armament, choice flag blessedRune with a fixed 5-option array), but no field lets a feat ADD options to another record's choice.options, so the two-to-four extra runes are unreachable.

engineWork.name: Raging Thrower
engineWork.reason: Rage's bonus damage must apply to THROWN weapon Strikes. derive.ts rageStrikeRider explicitly returns null for ranged Strikes (`if (opts.ranged) return null; // Rage never applies to ranged Strikes`), so a raging barbarian with this feat sees no bonus on thrown Strikes. The value is instinct- and level-scaled, so no flat field can express it — the rider needs a thrown-weapon exception gated on this feat.

engineWork.name: Razmiran Priest Dedication
engineWork.reason: Two real player-side grants nothing delivers: (a) you gain a Razmiri Mask item (the item exists in core.json — src/data/index.ts keeps 'razmiri-mask' — but no field lets a feat put an item in inventory), and (b) taking Cleric Dedication through this archetype re-traditions all its spells to occult with Charisma as key attribute. spellcastingGrant only creates a NEW entry; it cannot rewrite the tradition/key ability of the cleric archetype's grant, and the mask's DC = higher of class DC or spell DC has no lane either.

engineWork.name: Read the Land
engineWork.reason: 'You learn the Commune ritual if you didn't know it already' — a real grant of a known ritual (commune exists in core.json spells with ritual:true), plus a reduced casting time. There is no known-rituals lane at all: src/rules/build.ts line 2998 explicitly filters ritual spells OUT of addedSpells, and innateSpells/focusSpells are the wrong shape for a ritual.

engineWork.name: Beast of Burden
engineWork.reason: 'Increase your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits by 4' is a permanent sheet change. derive.ts computes bulk as encumberedAt = 5+strMod and max = 10+strMod with no per-feat adjustment lane (Hefty Hauler is undelivered for the same reason), and no legal field expresses a Bulk-limit bonus.

engineWork.name: Beastkin Resilience
engineWork.reason: 'You no longer gain silver weakness from Werecreature Dedication' must remove a weakness the app really applies — werecreature-dedication carries weaknesses [{type:'silver',value:'floor(@actor.level/2)'}]. There is no negation/removal lane for an already-granted weakness.

engineWork.name: Bestial Brutality
engineWork.reason: The Bestial Manifestation unarmed attack gains the deadly d6 trait (the app does compute deadly crit riders on strikes) and gets brawling critical specialization, but only for that one attack. There is no lane to add a trait to an already-granted strike, and critSpec + critSpecWeapons {groups:['brawling']} would hand brawling crit spec to every brawling attack the character has — an over-grant.

engineWork.name: Billowing Wings
engineWork.reason: Grants your winged animal companions a gust ranged unarmed attack (1d4 bludgeoning, 30 ft, air and propulsive). Companion strikes are rendered on the sheet (companions.ts formats them), but COMPANION_MODS has no attack-grant field — only strikeRider, senses, speeds, and note — so the companion attack lane is missing.

engineWork.name: Blessed Blood (Sorcerer)
engineWork.reason: 'Add up to three of your deity's spells to your spell list' is a build-time player pick that nothing offers. effectChoices/spellFilter cannot model it, because that would put the spells in the repertoire for free while the feat only makes them selectable with normal repertoire slots — the spell-LIST expansion lane does not exist.

engineWork.name: Bloodline Focus
engineWork.reason: 'Whenever you Refocus, completely refill your focus pool' changes a resource the app really tracks — the SpellsTab Refocus control restores exactly 1 Focus Point and nothing overrides that amount. focusPoolBonus only enlarges the pool, so no legal field expresses a Refocus-recovery change.

engineWork.name: Bloodline Wellspring
engineWork.reason: 'You recover 3 Focus Points when you Refocus instead of 1' — the same undelivered lane: the Refocus control hard-restores 1 point and there is no field for a Refocus-recovery amount.

engineWork.name: Restorative Channel
engineWork.reason: It widens what your divine-font slots may hold: a font Heal can be spent to cast Cleanse Affliction, Clear Mind, Sound Body, or Sure Footing at the sacrificed spell's rank. build.ts models the font with a fixed `allowed` list (used for Battle Creed) that no record field can extend, so the player cannot record or cast these from the sheet.

engineWork.name: Rod of Rule
engineWork.reason: Grants the critical specialization effects of the character's arcane bonded weapon (the second half, the -2 penalty to saves, is target-side). critSpec must be paired with critSpecWeapons, but the bonded weapon is chosen during play and cannot be enumerated in the record, so no existing field can express "crit spec with whatever weapon is your arcane bond".

engineWork.name: Sanguimancer Dedication
engineWork.reason: Grants a real player resource - sanguimancy Hit Points (temp HP equal to your level after an 8-hour rest, cap 2x level, spendable to power other feats). No field expresses a named, level-scaling, daily-refreshed temp-HP pool; limitedUses tracks fixed per-day uses only.

engineWork.name: Scroll Adept
engineWork.reason: Grants 2 (3 at master, 4 at legendary spell DC) player-chosen temporary scrolls from your spellbook at every daily preparation - exactly the 'let them pick what the rules give them' case. There is a daily-item lane for alchemy (advancedAlchemy) but none for temporary scrolls, and no field can express a per-day count of player-chosen scrolls with rank limits.

engineWork.name: Second Ikon
engineWork.reason: Grants an additional ikon - a pick the player must make. Ikons are an extra-choice group defined per class (ChoiceGroup.pickByLevel in src/rules/types.ts); no feat-level field increases an extra-choice pick count, and effectChoices cannot enumerate 'any ikon' (there is no featFilter).

engineWork.name: Shadow Spells
engineWork.reason: Adds seven named spells (Shadow Blast, Shadow Siphon, Umbral Journey, Replicate, Shadow Army, Shadow Projectile, Shadow Raid) to the character's own spell list so they can be learned/prepared off-tradition. Spell pickers filter strictly by tradition and there is no spell-list-addition lane (no field, no registry) to widen that list.

engineWork.name: Share Eidolon Magic
engineWork.reason: Lets the summoner cast the eidolon's innate spells from Magical Understudy/Adept/Master (shared daily uses). No eidolon innate-spellcasting lane exists — Magical Understudy carries no field either — so there is nothing to project onto the summoner's spell list, and innateSpells cannot express it without over-granting spells the character's actual evolution feats may not include.

engineWork.name: Shield Warfare
engineWork.reason: Increases the weapon damage die of any shield bash, shield boss, or shield spikes you wield by one step — a real, permanent damage change. Shields are modelled only as AC/Hardness/HP (deriveShield); no shield attack exists in the strikes lane and unarmedTraits.stepDie only reaches unarmed Strikes, so no field can step a shield attack's die.

engineWork.name: Signature Spell Expansion
engineWork.reason: Grants two additional signature spells of base rank 3rd or lower — a genuine player PICK. The builder stores signatures as Record<rank, spellId> (BuildState.signatures, src/rules/build.ts ~222 and Builder.tsx ~661), one per rank, so a sorcerer cannot designate a second signature at any rank ≤3 and this feat does nothing. No existing field can express extra signature slots.

engineWork.name: Signature Spell Expansion (Psychic)
engineWork.reason: Same as the sorcerer version: two additional signature spells of rank 3rd or lower. BuildState.signatures is one spell per rank, so the psychic gets nothing. No existing field expresses extra signature slots.

engineWork.name: Spell Combination
engineWork.reason: The 20th-level wizard capstone converts one prepared slot of every rank except 1st and 2nd into a combination slot that holds TWO spells at once. That is a real change to spell preparation the player cannot record: spellSlotBonus adds slots rather than re-typing them, and no field marks a slot as a combination slot or lets two spells be prepared in one.

engineWork.name: Splinter Faith
engineWork.reason: You choose four domains that REPLACE your deity's domain list, and the app's domain picker (choice kind 'domains' in Builder.tsx) enumerates strictly content.deities[deityId].domains, so Domain Initiate and friends still offer only the printed list. No field can override a deity's domain set.

engineWork.name: Strong Arm
engineWork.reason: It permanently increases the range increment of every thrown weapon you Strike with — a number the strike card shows — and there is no field or registry that modifies weapon range.

engineWork.name: Student of Water
engineWork.reason: It hands you Underwater Marauder and Water Sprint, but only once you meet each one’s prerequisite (trained / master in Athletics). grantsFeats applies unconditionally, so writing it would give a 2nd-level monk the 7th-level Water Sprint — a prerequisite-gated feat grant has no lane.

engineWork.name: Tactical Expansion
engineWork.reason: Repeatable: "Add two additional tactics you qualify for to your folio." Tactics are real records (core.json `tactic` / actions with the tactic trait) and the folio is built by commanderFolioMax() in src/rules/build.ts, a fixed formula no record can influence. A folio-size grant field (repeatable, +2 each time) does not exist.

engineWork.name: Talismanic Sage
engineWork.reason: Lets one specially treated item hold two active talismans at once. The app enforces the opposite: attachKind()/the host rule in src/rules/attachments.ts allows a host at most one talisman, so this feat is actively contradicted by the engine and no field relaxes the cap for a nominated item.

engineWork.name: Tempest Cloud's Speed
engineWork.reason: The feat permanently gives your familiar the Path of the Tempest familiar ability (an activation that grants YOU a +10-foot status bonus to Speed, reaction-free Striding and a Long Jump without a Stride). The record carries nothing and the familiar's ability roster never shows it; the COMPANION_MODS registry is the existing lane for feats that modify an existing companion.

engineWork.name: Terrifying Mien
engineWork.reason: Grants the PLAYER a standing resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from Strikes made by frightened creatures, equal to four times that attacker's frightened value. Nothing delivers it: the resistances field is unconditional and its value can only reference the actor, so there is no way to key a resistance to the ATTACKER's condition value (and a flat resistance here would be a large over-grant).

engineWork.name: Bolstered Recovery
engineWork.reason: Grants the Instant Recovery action and doubles rest recovery. Instant Recovery exists only in content.actions (no feat record), and grantsFeats resolves solely against content.feats (src/rules/build.ts ~2343), so the granted action can never reach the sheet; there is also no lane for scaling nightly rest recovery.

engineWork.name: Ubiquitous Gadgets
engineWork.reason: Raises the inventor's daily temporary-gadget count by 2 (repeatable at 14th for +4 total) — a per-day player resource. Nothing in src models gadgets at all: there is no 'gadgets' entry in src/rules/classResources.ts, so resourceMaxSet has no resourceId to target, and no advancedAlchemy-style count field exists for Gadget Specialist.

engineWork.name: Ubiquitous Snares
engineWork.reason: Doubles the free daily prepared snares from Snare Specialist (4/6/8 by Crafting rank becomes 8/12/16). The app already computes that allowance in src/rules/snareFormulas.ts snareAllowance(), but the number is hardcoded off Crafting rank with no record field able to modify it.

engineWork.name: Ultimate Polymath
engineWork.reason: Makes EVERY spell in the bard's repertoire a signature spell, which drives the app's 'cast at' heightening picker. The engine only produces all-repertoire signatures from the summoner class feature check ('unlimited-signature-spells', src/rules/build.ts:1766-1771); there is no record field a feat can set, and no entry exists for this feat.

engineWork.name: Unburdened Iron
engineWork.reason: 'Ignore the reduction to your Speed from any armor you wear' plus a 5-foot reduction to one other Speed penalty. The app really does subtract the worn armor's Speed penalty from every Speed (src/rules/derive.ts:1926) and applies encumbered as -10, with no check for this feat and no record field that waives a penalty (speedPenalty only ADDS one; landSpeedBonus would over-grant when unarmored).

engineWork.name: Untrained Improvisation
engineWork.reason: The record carries untrainedProficiency {levelMinus:2}, but untrainedSkillBonus (src/rules/derive.ts:305-315) computes level − levelMinus with no scaling, so the player is stuck at level−2 forever; the printed feat improves to level−1 at 5th and full level at 7th. The lane needs a level-keyed levelMinus (or a scale table) before this feat can be delivered correctly.

engineWork.name: Venomous Weapons
engineWork.reason: Wielded blowguns and slings gain the venomous trait — a permanent change to the player's weapons that nothing delivers. There is no lane to add a trait to a MANUFACTURED weapon (unarmedTraits is unarmed-only, and core.json's 'venomous' trait record is a bare stub with no description), so the strike line and the item's trait list never show it.

engineWork.name: Versatile Blasts
engineWork.reason: Adds selectable damage types to your Elemental Blasts (air/fire cold, earth/wood poison, metal electricity, water acid). deriveBlastStrikes (src/rules/derive.ts ~1537) hardcodes one damage type per element from ELEMENT_BLAST with no alternative, and no record field can add blast damage types, so the sheet can never show the type the player chose.

engineWork.name: Versatile Font
engineWork.reason: Lets you prepare either Harm or Heal in every divine-font slot. build.ts pins the font entry to a single type ({type: build.divineFont}) and SpellsTab renders that one spell for each pip, so half the feat's slots are shown as the wrong spell. The battle-font 'allowed' list is the existing mechanism, but nothing keys it to this feat — no record field can express it.

engineWork.name: Walk the Wilds
engineWork.reason: Adds Animal Form to the animist apparition spell repertoire, which the app does build (build.ts animist-apparition-casting) — but no field can add a spell to a repertoire.

engineWork.name: Winged Warrior Dedication
engineWork.reason: Permanently increases any fly Speed granted by ancestry feats/permanent wings by 5 feet, which is a persistent sheet speed. No lane exists: 'speeds' only sets an absolute value and landSpeedBonus covers land Speed only, so there is no way to add +5 to an existing fly Speed. (The Leap +10 feet half correctly needs nothing, matching Powerful Leap/Winglets which carry no field.)

engineWork.name: Cantrip Casting
engineWork.reason: Grants two additional cantrips from the matching tradition — a real spellcasting resource the player should be able to PICK. spellSlotBonus cannot deliver it: build.ts filters slot grants to ranks > 0, so rank-0 (cantrip) counts are unreachable, and no other field expresses a cantrip-count increase.

engineWork.name: Cantrip Expansion
engineWork.reason: Two extra cantrips prepared per day (prepared casters) or two extra cantrips added to the repertoire (spontaneous) — a picked spellcasting resource. Same missing lane as Cantrip Casting: spellSlotBonus explicitly skips rank 0, so nothing can grant cantrip capacity.

engineWork.name: Cutting Heaven, Crushing Earth
engineWork.reason: While you wear invested handwraps of mighty blows, their runes also apply to one wielded weapon usable with Overwhelming Combination - a real change to that weapon's attack bonus, striking dice and property runes on the Strikes page. derive.ts:1005 (bestHandwrapsRunes) applies handwraps runes to unarmed Strikes only, and no legal field redirects them to a carried weapon. The two off-guard clauses are target-side and correctly ignored.

engineWork.name: Deadly Aspect
engineWork.reason: The unarmed attack granted by Draconic Aspect permanently gains the deadly d8 trait, which changes the crit damage line the Strikes page prints (derive.ts:1421 reads deadly-dN off the strike's traits). No legal field injects a trait onto an already-granted strike.

engineWork.name: Deadly Grace
engineWork.reason: Any agile or finesse melee weapon you wield that lacks the deadly trait gains deadly d8, and deadly dice double on a crit - both change the crit line the Strikes page prints, and no field injects a weapon trait or alters deadly-dice multiplication.

engineWork.name: Deadly Strikes
engineWork.reason: All your unarmed attacks gain (or upgrade to) deadly d10, changing the crit damage line printed for every unarmed Strike; no legal field injects a deadly trait onto unarmed attacks.

engineWork.name: Demon's Hair
engineWork.reason: Self-facing package: your hair unarmed Strike's damage die steps up and it gains reach and versatile slashing (or sweep if it already had reach), and you are permanently quickened (extra action limited to a hair Strike) while your familiar is alive within 30 feet. No legal field upgrades a granted unarmed attack's damage die, adds weapon traits to it, or grants standing quickened.

engineWork.name: Devoted Focus
engineWork.reason: Refocus completely refills your focus pool instead of restoring 1 point - a permanent change to a resource the app tracks; the Refocus button in src/sheet/SpellsTab.tsx restores exactly 1 point. focusPoolBonus only raises the maximum, so no legal field expresses this.

engineWork.name: Diamond Fists
engineWork.reason: All your unarmed attacks gain the forceful and deadly d10 traits, and any that already had one increase their weapon damage dice by one step - a permanent change to every unarmed Strike shown on the Strikes tab. No legal field adds weapon traits to unarmed attacks or steps up their damage dice.

engineWork.name: Diehard
engineWork.reason: You die at dying 5 instead of dying 4. The app computes this exact number - dyingDeathThreshold() in src/rules/conditions.ts returns Math.max(1, 4 - doomed) and src/rules/play.ts drives the dying tracker from it - and Diehard appears only as a granted feat in src/rules/featFeatGrants.ts, never raising the base 4.
